narrative.details:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, adventurer. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Rough Quartz to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done! Know this - totems ain't just a mark of yer place among shamans. They're tools, a focus for spells tied to stone, soil, and other elements. As ye grow wiser, more o' the mountain's power will open to ye. The trainers will know when yer ready for more. But for now, take this totem, and let the ground speak through ye.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ahh, ye've returned. If ye have the stone, it means the mountain's chosen ye true. I'll give ye the totem it promised. But if ye've come empty-handed, off with ye! The path ain't for those who forget their way.
